mapper.insert: insert into book_review(book_title, reviewer_name, rating, review_content, review_time) values(#{bookTitle}, #{reviewerName}, #{rating}, #{reviewContent}, #{reviewTime})
mapper.update: update book_review set book_title = #{bookTitle}, reviewer_name = #{reviewerName}, rating = #{rating}, review_content = #{reviewContent}, review_time = #{reviewTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select count(*) from book_review
and (book_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or reviewer_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or review_content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
